empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write one from scratch, or import a skill from a Markdown file or a .zip archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a reusable block of instructions you link to one or more agents, in order.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import a skill from a Markdown file or a .zip archive

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: This body becomes part of the reviewing agent's instructions — it arrives disabled until a human vets it.
file.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body becomes part of the reviewing agent's instructions, so it must be read and vetted by a person before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

editor.runOnEvalsDisabled: Evals are coming in a later lesson.

config.descriptionPlaceholder: List the uncovered branches in the diff and flag any removed test assertions.
config.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface — one imperative sentence about what the skill makes the agent do. Write "List the uncovered branches…", not "About test coverage."
config.bodyTokensHint: Approximate — the exact count depends on the model's tokenizer.

stats.disclaimer: Metrics are aggregated over the agents this skill is linked to right now. This is correlation, not attribution: a finding is not attributed to any one skill, and changing links rewrites the history.

versions.confirmRestore: Restore v{version}? This creates a new version with v{version}'s body.

evals.comingSoon: Evals are coming in a later lesson.

delete.title: Delete skill?
delete.body: This removes the skill and unlinks it from every agent. This can't be undone.

context.title: Project context
context.scopeNote: Showing the documents found in {repo}. An attachment is stored as a file path, not a link to a repository — every run resolves those paths against the repository the run is on.
context.orderHint: Order matters — earlier documents appear earlier in the assembled prompt. Toggle to attach; drag a row or use the arrows to reorder.
context.missingTitle: This path is not in the document list for {repo}. It may be attached from a different repository, or it may have been deleted, renamed, or dropped beyond the discovery cap — this page cannot tell which. The attachment is kept, and each run resolves it against the repository that run is on.
context.tokenEstimate: ≈{tokens, number} tokens per run — an estimate, not an exact count
context.saveErrorLimit: Not saved — an agent or skill may attach at most {max} documents. Detach one first.
context.saveErrorInvalidPath: Not saved — one of those paths is not a project document path.
context.saveErrorOwnerGone: Not saved — this agent or skill no longer exists. Reload the page.
context.saveErrorServer: Not saved — the server could not complete the change. Try again.
context.loadError: Could not load the project documents or the current attachments. Nothing is editable until they load — saving now would overwrite the existing attachments.
context.noDocumentsBody: This repository has no markdown under docs/, specs/, plans/ or insights/, or it has not been cloned yet. Open Project Context to check.
